# implicitOp='&' (pattern has *T, target has T) and replacement is *ptr.
# The & and * should cancel.
ex {
	var p *S
	p.F -> NewF(p.F)
}
-- file.go --
package m

type S struct{ F int }

func NewF(v int) int { return v + 1 }

var g S

func example() {
	_ = g.F
}
-- stdout --
diff old/file.go new/file.go
--- old/file.go
+++ new/file.go
@@ -7,5 +7,5 @@
 var g S

 func example() {
-	_ = g.F
+	_ = NewF(g.F)
 }
